notes: Today an agreed meeting is recorded as 'Arranged in person' with no place. Attending it asks for no journey and plays no scene, which fixed the owner's stuck Attend button but leaves the meeting placeless.

title: Where two people meet when they agree to
usableAnswer: Rules for choosing the meeting place from real place kinds (either home, a workplace, a public venue kind such as a cafe, park, bar or place of worship), what selects among them, and whether the choice is ever negotiated.
